LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Kin.AncestorCoreFuneralDesc: Choose a dead kin to be carried to the Ancestor Core and uploaded.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Kin.AncestorCoreCancelFunera: Stop hauling {0} to the Ancestor Core.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Kin.AncestorCoreUnpowered: Unpowered: shared knowledge is not being transmitted.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Kin.CrucibleGrowDesc: Start the process to grow a new Kin
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Kin.CrucibleNoAncestorCore: Not linked to an Ancestor Core
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Kin.CrucibleLeagueDesc: Choose which Kin League the next kin grown in this crucible will belong to. The league decides which league gene the kin is born with. It cannot be changed while a kin is growing.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Kin.CrucibleLeagueLocked: A kin is already being grown; the league is fixed until the cycle ends.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Contract.Title: Kin Contracts
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Contract.GoodwillTooltip: How much the Kin think of you. Goes from -100 to 100; at -100 they are hostile. Completing contracts and paying tribute raises it, failing contracts lowers it.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Contract.PriceMultTooltip: This is the price multiplier on the things they'll trade you. Over 1 being in your favor and below being in theirs. Scales off goodwill.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Contract.MaximumContractsToo: Maximum amount of offered contracts. Scales off goodwill.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Contract.HostileDebt: The Kin hold a grudge against you. Outstanding debt: {0} silver. Pay tribute to settle it.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Contract.BecameHostile: The Kin have run out of patience with unpaid debts.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Contract.BecameNeutral: The Kin consider the debt settled.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Contract.InfoDesc:
The Kin want {0}. In return they offer {1} x{2}.

On acceptance a Kin drill will surface next to the item within a couple of hours, dropping their goods beside it. Your haulers then load the requested item into the drill, which leaves on its own when its time is up. If it leaves empty, the Kin will come to collect.

Offer expires in {3}.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Contract.InfoDrillEnRoute: Accepted. A Kin drill carrying {0} x{1} is tunnelling towards {2} and will surface in {3}.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Contract.InfoLoading: The drill has surfaced and is waiting for {0}. Load it and send it, or it leaves on its own in {1}.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Contract.InfoCompleted: Completed. {0} was delivered to the Kin.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Contract.InfoFailed: Failed. {0} was never delivered; the Kin will collect their due.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Contract.PayTributeTooltip: Request a Kin drill and load it with silver to pay off your debt to the Kin. Enough tribute ends hostilities.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Contract.TributeDrillRequest: A Kin drill will surface at your trade spot in {0} to collect tribute.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Contract.TributePaid: The Kin accepted {0} silver in tribute. Remaining debt: {1}.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Contract.AcceptedMessage: The Kin have agreed to trade {1} x{2} for {0}. Their drill will surface near the item in {3}.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Contract.CompletedMessage: The Kin drill left with {0}. The Kin are pleased with the exchange.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Contract.FailedMessage: The Kin drill left without {0}. The Kin do not forgive a broken bargain: a reclamation party will come for the item and a {1} silver penalty.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Drill.ArrivedMessage: A Kin drill has surfaced and dropped {0} x{1}. Load {2} into it before it leaves in {3}.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Drill.TributeArrived: A Kin drill has surfaced to collect tribute. Load it with silver.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Drill.SendDesc: Send the drill back to the Kin with the loaded goods now.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Drill.SendTributeDesc: Send the drill back to the Kin with the loaded silver.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Drill.UnloadDesc: Drop everything loaded into the drill back onto the ground.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Reclamation.IncomingMessage: The ground is rumbling. A Kin reclamation party is tunnelling up to collect {0} and a {1} silver penalty. They will not fight unless attacked - but they will go through walls to get what they are owed.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Reclamation.ArrivedMessage: A Kin reclamation party has climbed out of the ground. They are here for {0} and {1} silver.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Reclamation.AttackedMessage: You attacked the Kin reclamation party. The Kin are now hostile and the party is assaulting your colony.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Reclamation.ItemMissing: The Kin could not find what they were owed. They are now hostile and will take its value in silver and goods instead.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Reclamation.Left: The Kin reclamation party has gone back underground with goods worth {0} silver.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Reclamation.HoleInspect: Kin tunnel. It will seal itself once the reclaimers are gone.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.PlacementLimit.RequiresKin: Requires a colonist with the 'Cloneskein' gene on the map to place.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Grudge.Title: Grudges
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Grudge.OnlyKin: only kin may read the ledger
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Grudge.InspectLocked: May be reforged after {0} more kills, or in {1}.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Grudge.HeaderTooltip: While a grudge stands, every kin deals extra damage to that faction, and kin gain mood for each of them killed. The bonus grows as more of them are struck out.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Grudge.ReforgeTooltip: A grudge cannot be swapped at the stone until enough of them are dead, or enough time has passed. It can still be abandoned in the moment, when they kill one of your kin.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Grudge.SelectFaction: Select a faction to read their entry.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Grudge.SwearDisabledLocked: The grudge against {0} must run its course first.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Grudge.SwearConfirm: Record a grudge against {0}?\n\nWord will reach them: {1} goodwill. The grudge cannot be swapped again until enough of them are dead or enough time has passed.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Grudge.InfoLedger: The ledger against {0} runs to {1} names.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Grudge.InfoTiers:
Judgement:
 Marked - {0} damage from kin
 Judged - after {1} kills, {2} damage
 Doomed - after {3} kills, {4} damage
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Grudge.InfoIsCurrent: This grudge stands at {0}, on {1} kills.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Grudge.InfoCost: Swearing costs {0} goodwill with them. Old scores carry over: this grudge would start on {1} kills.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Grudge.InfoLocked: The grudge against {0} still stands. It may be reforged after {1} more kills, or in {2}.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Grudge.InfoKinGrudge: The offworld kin have sworn against them too. {0} killed so far.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Grudge.SwornMessage: A grudge is cut into the stone against {0}. Every kin will strike them harder until it is settled.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Grudge.SwornMessageReplaced: A grudge is cut into the stone against {0}.\n\nThe unfinished grudge against {1} was struck through. The offworld kin note the abandonment: {2} silver added to your debt.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Grudge.StruckOutMessage: {0} are gone. The grudge against them is struck out, and the stone stands empty.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Grudge.KinGrudgeChanged: The offworld kin have sworn a grudge against {0}.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Grudge.LetterText: {0} was killed by {1}.\n\nRecord a grudge against them? Every kin will deal extra damage to {1}, and word will reach them - at a cost to your standing.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Grudge.LetterTextReplace: {0} was killed by {1}.\n\nRecord a grudge against them? The unfinished grudge against {2} would be struck through, and the offworld kin would add {3} silver to your debt for the abandonment.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Contract.KinGrudge: The Kin have sworn against {0} - settle it and your debt lightens. ({1} struck out)
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.Contract.KinGrudgeTooltip: The offworld Kin hold their own grudge, and it moves on its own. Every member of that faction your colony kills lowers your debt, more so when the killer is kin, and more again when you hold the same grudge.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.ModSettings.GrudgeReforgeKil: Kills before a grudge may be reforged: {0}
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.ModSettings.GrudgeReforgeDay: Days before a grudge may be reforged: {0}
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.ModSettings.GrudgeReforgeToo: Whichever comes first unlocks the grudgestone.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.ModSettings.GrudgeSwearCost: Goodwill lost with a faction when swearing: {0}
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.ModSettings.GrudgeBreakDebt: Debt for abandoning a fresh grudge: {0}
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.ModSettings.GrudgeBreakDebtT: Scales down to nothing as the grudge nears completion.

Any of your pawns counts. Goodwill with the offworld Kin is derived from your debt, so this raises it.

LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.ModSettings.KinGrudgeAligned: Multiplier when you hold the same grudge: {0}
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.ModSettings.KinGrudgeDebtFlo: Killing stops lowering your debt past this point. Contracts and tribute still do.
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.ModSettings.KinGrudgeRerollD: Days between the Kin picking a new grudge: {0}
LanguageData.BEWH.Votann.ModSettings.KinGrudgeRerollT: They also re-pick immediately if their target is defeated or no longer hostile.
